title: Sacha Baron Cohen Talks New Ali G Movie with Howard Stern
summary: This week, Jimmy Kimmel Live! is broadcasting from the Brooklyn Academy of Music (BAM) in New York City.
body_markdown:
On Monday, October 19,[Sacha Baron Cohen](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/sacha-baron-cohen) returned to *The Howard Stern Show* . Listen to the show on satellite channel 100 and on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSachaBaronCohenHSS) , and watch a clip from the interview below now.


[Sacha Baron Cohen The Howard Stern Show Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSachaBaronCohenHSS)


Sacha Baron Cohen is back as Ali G in his new movie, *Ali G: Who Iz I?* , after a 20-year hiatus. Sacha’s directorial debut hits theaters on October 23.


[Howard Stern](https://www.siriusxm.com/talk/howard-stern) is best known for his deep, wide-ranging long-form discussions with iconic figures across music, comedy, entertainment and beyond. Howard’s legendary interview, comedy and entertainment radio show, “The Howard Stern Show,” airs exclusively on SiriusXM, where Howard has produced two channels of new and classic shows since 2006.


Listen to Howard’s exclusive SiriusXM channel –[Howard 100 (Ch. 100)](https://www.siriusxm.com/channels/howard-100) – anytime in the car and on the SiriusXM app.
